Pulls the most anticipated new shows.

Adds movies released in the region over the last weeks.
Fetches the movies now playing in cinemas in the region.

Records the daily watcher and rating snapshot of catalog titles that trend charts are built from.

queues.name: ingestion
queues.description: Imports and refreshes titles from rate-limited providers; scheduled syncs land here, so backlog spikes after them are normal.

queues.name: backfill
queues.description: Fast TMDB-only fill-ins (missing IDs, alternative titles) and watch history imports.

queues.name: ratings-backfill
queues.description: External ratings under a small daily quota; drains slowly all day by design, so a long backlog is normal.

queues.name: catalog-policy-queue
queues.description: Decides which titles are eligible for the public catalog.

queues.name: stats-queue
queues.description: Recomputes title stats and the homepage blocks.

queues.name: monitoring-queue
queues.description: Health probes such as the API key check.
